rows.observation: Sun Flare 指太阳耀斑；“日珥”是不同的太阳现象，译文改变了名称所指。
rows.conclusion: talents/celestial/sunlight.lua:69 技能名 Sun Flare（光系球形爆发，致盲并造成光伤）；flare 为“耀斑”，现译“日珥闪耀”的日珥（prominence）是另一种太阳现象。全库“日珥”“耀斑”各仅此一处，无引用同步与冲突，改为“太阳耀斑”一类属单条纠错而非全局重命名。

rows.observation: 原文“debilitated by noxious blight”是受到剧毒枯萎削弱；译文“吸入过多剧毒瘴气”增添了吸入和过量的含义。
rows.conclusion: damage_types.lua:909 枯萎伤害 death_message 列表中的 debilitated by noxious blight before falling；现译“死前吸入过多剧毒瘴气”增出“吸入/过量”。死亡描述词表整族已由用户 2026-09-16 裁定继续 pending（pending-user-review 第 13 项先例），单改一条会造成族内不一致，列入待用户审阅。

rows.observation: 原文 deflected 表示偏转或弹开，译文「敏捷防御」改变了含义。
rows.conclusion: talents/techniques/agility.lua:71 盾牌敏捷格挡：delayedLogDamage 显示被抵消的伤害量 ("%s(%d deflected)#LAST#"，lastdam - dam)；现译“(%d 敏捷防御)”把偏转量说成防御名称。改为“(%d 被偏转)”一类，%s/%d 与 #LAST# 保持。

rows.observation: 原文末尾有空格，译文删去了该空格；若后面直接拼接内容，会失去间隔。
rows.conclusion: dialogs/CharacterSheet.lua:225 免疫表列标题：英文末尾空格仅为与 Physical Status 等宽对齐；同族 All Status/Mental Status 的英文填充空格在中文译文中同样去掉（mod-tome.lua:41361–41363），中文标签等宽，不存在拼接失距。

rows.observation: 原文为连续段落，译文在首句后额外加入换行和制表符，改变了格式。
rows.conclusion: lore/blighted-ruins.lua:27 原文为单段连续文本（0 个 LF），现译在首段后插入 \n\t（一级换行不变量）。整条修复：删去该换行与制表符，其余逐句对照。

rows.observation: 原文说世界是居住者共同的梦，唤醒沉睡者可发掘梦的潜能；译文改成世界由许多梦境组成、唤醒后打开通往梦境之门，含义明显偏离。
rows.conclusion: birth/classes/psionic.lua:139 Solipsist 职业说明引语：the world is the collective dream of those that live in it（世界是其居民共同的梦）；unlock the potential of your dreams（发掘你梦境的潜能）。现译“由许多个梦境组成”“打开通往梦境之门”偏离原意。整条修复。

rows.observation: 原文说明在静电网内每停留一回合，下一次攻击的额外闪电伤害就增加 %0.1f；译文遗漏了按停留回合累加这一条件。
rows.conclusion: talents/psionic/charged-mastery.lua:119–122 静电网：add %0.1f additional Lightning damage to your next attack for each turn you spend within its area——每在网中停留一回合累加一次；现译漏“每停留一回合”，读作固定一次加成（删限定词类缺陷）。整条修复，%d/%0.1f/%d%% 顺序与 \n\t\t 保持。

rows.observation: The source damage_types.lua:909 is one of the death_message entries for the blight damage type. PartyDeath.lua:71,107 picks one at random and puts it in the 'was %s to death by %s' template, so the source means the victim was weakened/debilitated by noxious blight before falling. The target, 死前吸入过多剧毒瘴气 ('inhaled too much toxic miasma before dying'), rewrites both 'debilitated' and 'blight' as inhaling a poisonous gas (瘴气). Blight is corruption/withering damage, not a gas, so the damage-type meaning is misrepresented.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同向（contextual 另指 blight 为腐化/枯萎伤害而非气体，PartyDeath.lua:71,107 代入“was %s to death by %s”）。死亡描述词表整族由用户 2026-09-16 裁定继续 pending，本条作为该族新证据列入 pending-user-review，不单改。

rows.observation: The source agility.lua:69-71 is the Agile Defense damage log. The %d is lastdam-dam, the amount of damage the shield deflected and removed. The target, (%d 敏捷防御), replaces 'deflected' with what reads like the talent name ('Agile Defense'), so it no longer says the number is damage deflected/reduced and the log is ambiguous. It should keep the meaning 'N deflected' (for example, 偏斜 %d).
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同向：agility.lua:69–71 %d 为 lastdam-dam 即被盾牌偏转抵消的伤害量；现译“敏捷防御”读作技能名。整条修复为“(%d 被偏转)”一类。

rows.observation: The source blighted-ruins.lua:27 is a single lore paragraph with no line breaks. The target adds a '\n\t' (newline plus tab) after the second sentence (这令我很不悦。). That is a newline/whitespace change with no source counterpart and will show a stray line break and tab in the lore text.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同向：blighted-ruins.lua:27 单段无换行，现译插入 \n\t（一级换行不变量）。整条修复。

rows.observation: This is the Solipsist locked_desc (psionic.lua:139). Error 1: the source says the world is the single collective dream of the people who live in it, but the target says 世界由许多个梦境组成 (the world is made of many separate dreams), which contradicts the next line (141) about 'the collective vision of those that experience it'. Error 2: 'you'll unlock the potential of your dreams' is rewritten as 打开通往梦境之门 ('open the door to the dream world'). That drops the meaning of unlocking the potential of your dreams, which matters because this line is the unlock hint for the class.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同向，并补充：下一行 psionic.lua:141 讲“the collective vision of those that experience it”，现译“许多个梦境”与之矛盾；unlock the potential of your dreams 被改为“打开通往梦境之门”。整条修复。

rows.observation: The target drops the qualifier 'for each turn you spend within its area'. Per damage_types.lua:3935-3946, the STATIC_NET projector gives the caster STATIC_CHARGE (power=weapon) every turn they stand in the net, and mental.lua:2812-2813 on_merge adds power=new+old. The bonus therefore stacks %0.1f for each turn spent in the net. The target, 让你的下一次攻击造成额外 %0.1f 的闪电伤害, reads as a flat %0.1f total, which understates how the bonus scales.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同向：damage_types.lua:3935–3946 每回合在网中给予 STATIC_CHARGE，mental.lua:2812–2813 on_merge 叠加 power，故加成按停留回合累加；现译漏 for each turn you spend within its area。整条修复。
